hook.name: QuiverHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Quiver protocol that sets asymmetric LP fees (quiverFee vs pairedFee) based on swap direction via updateDynamicLPFee, and collects protocol fees on the non-Quiver token side of each swap using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Includes optional MEV protection via an external module active for 2 minutes after pool creation.
